subject.title: [Bug]: v2026.6.9 regression — Codex app-server runs stamp internal turns "webchat"-bound, so heartbeat notification sends to Discord are silently denied (cross-context)

question: Which linked fix path should be treated as canonical for #102206's Codex internal-turn cross-provider delivery regression?
rationale: The issue is source-reproducible on main, but the open PRs make different compatibility and message-delivery tradeoffs around WebChat binding and internal turns.

options.title: Review and land #102232

options.title: Adopt a broader linked PR
options.body: Choose #102217 only if maintainers explicitly accept its broader behavior and proof after compatibility review.

options.title: Request a replacement fix
